source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 22.3, printed pages 88-89 (PDF 91-92).

blocks.text: Alcohols alkenes, halogenoalkanes, carbonyl compounds, carboxylic acids aur esters se banaye ja sakte hain.
i) Jab garam steam (bhaap) ko alkene se react karaya jaye aur concentrated phosphoric acid (H₃PO₄) catalyst ho, to electrophilic addition (jurna) hota hai aur alcohol banta hai.

blocks.alt: Displayed ethene + H2O(g), arrow ke oopar H3PO4 aur neeche heat, se displayed ethanol. Labels: ethene, steam (bhaap), ethanol.
blocks.caption: i) Ethene aur bhaap se ethanol (kitab ke PDF page 91 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Ethene ke C=C double bond par paani ka H ek carbon par aur OH doosre carbon par jur jata hai, aur ethanol ban jata hai. H₃PO₄ catalyst hai aur heat (garmi) di jati hai.
ii. Alkenes ko cold (thande), dilute (halke) KMnO₄ se oxidise karne par bhi alcohol milta hai; KMnO₄ yahan mild (halka) oxidising agent hai.

blocks.alt: Displayed ethene + H2O + [O], arrow ke oopar KMnO4 aur neeche OH-, se displayed ethane-1,2-diol, HO-CH2-CH2-OH. Labels: ethene, ethane-1,2-diol.
blocks.caption: ii) Oxidation of alkenes using cold, dilute KMnO4 to form a diol: thande, dilute KMnO4 se alkenes ki oxidation se diol (kitab ke PDF page 91 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke caption mein 'to from a diol' chhapa hai; sahi 'to form a diol' (diol banana) hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Double bond ke dono carbons par ek ek -OH lag jata hai, is liye do -OH wala alcohol, ethane-1,2-diol, banta hai.
iii) Halogenoalkane ko aqueous (paani wale) NaOH ke saath garam karne par halogen atom ki jagah -OH group aa jata hai. Yeh nucleophilic substitution (badal dena) reaction hai aur alcohol banta hai.

blocks.alt: Displayed bromoethane + NaOH, arrow ke oopar Heat, se displayed ethanol + NaBr. Labels: bromoethane, ethanol.
blocks.caption: iii) Bromoethane aur aqueous sodium hydroxide se ethanol (kitab ke PDF page 92 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: iv) Aldehydes aur ketones ko NaBH₄ ya LiAlH₄ jaise reducing agents se reduce kar ke alcohols banaye jate hain. Aldehydes se primary alcohols bante hain aur ketones se secondary alcohols.

blocks.alt: Do equations, arrow ke oopar LiAlH4. Displayed ethanal (C=O ke saath H) + 2[H] se ethanol (primary alcohol). Displayed propanone (teen carbons ke beech C=O) + 2[H] se propan-2-ol, beech wale carbon par OH (secondary alcohol).
blocks.caption: iv) Ethanal aur propanone ki reduction (kitab ke PDF page 92 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Aldehyde (ethanal) mein C=O chain ke end par hai, is liye do H milne par -CH₂OH, yani primary alcohol, banta hai. Ketone (propanone) mein C=O beech mein hai, is liye -CH(OH)-, yani secondary alcohol, banta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text:
Kitab ne propan-2-ol ke neeche 'secondary alchol' chhapa hai.
Sahi spelling: secondary alcohol.
v) Isi tarah carboxylic acids LiAlH₄ se reduce ho kar primary alcohols bante hain.

blocks.alt: Displayed ethanoic acid (C=O ke saath OH) + 4[H], arrow ke oopar LiAlH4, se displayed ethanol + H2O. Labels: ethanoic acid, ethanol.
blocks.caption: v) Ethanoic acid ki reduction se ethanol (kitab ke PDF page 92 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: vi) Ester ko dilute acid ya alkali ke saath garam karne par hydrolysis (pani se tootna) hoti hai aur carboxylic acid aur alcohol bante hain.

blocks.alt: CH3-C(=O)-O-CH2-CH3 + H2O, equilibrium arrowon ke oopar H+(aq), se CH3-C(=O)-OH + CH3-CH2-OH. Labels: ethyl ethanoate, ethanoic acid.
blocks.caption: vi) Ethyl ethanoate ki hydrolysis (kitab ke PDF page 92 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa reducing agent carboxylic acid ko alcohol mein badal sakta hai, aur kis type ka alcohol banta hai?
blocks.explanation: LiAlH₄; primary alcohol banta hai (jaise ethanoic acid se ethanol).

items: Alkene + steam (H₃PO₄, heat) se alcohol; alkene + thanda dilute KMnO₄ se diol.
Aldehyde se primary aur ketone se secondary alcohol (NaBH₄ ya LiAlH₄); carboxylic acid se primary alcohol (LiAlH₄).
Ester + dilute acid ya alkali (heat) se carboxylic acid + alcohol.
